name: @atomiqlabs/sdk
description: atomiq labs SDK for cross-chain swaps between smart chains and bitcoin

scripts.build: npx -y -p typescript@4.9 tsc && npx -y -p typescript@4.9 tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist-esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module',sideEffects:false}))" && node -e "require('./dist/index.js')" && node -e "import('./dist-esm/index.js')"
scripts.build:ts4: npx -y -p typescript@4.9 tsc --noEmit && npx -y -p typescript@4.9 tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json --noEmit
scripts.build:ts5: npx -y -p typescript@5.9 tsc --noEmit && npx -y -p typescript@5.9 tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json --noEmit

author: adambor
